docs.title: MILK-spec
docs.text:
Specifications and design board for CACAOv2.

Relevant repositories:

  • milk-spec -- this.
  • milk -- main repo.
  • cacao -- as an embed (not a submodule) in milk.
  • ImageStreamIO -- as a submodule in milk.

Other info:

  • camstack -- the command-control server for cameras on SCExAO
  • hardwaresecrets -- drivers & hardware linkage to ImageStreamIO.
  • XWCTk arxiv -- MagAO-X application layer for instrument control and CACAO RTC orchestration. May be lots to pick up there.
